_doc: Dialog for The Pyre interior — Elder Moss and sacred fire shrine.

elder_moss.name: Elder Moss
intro: Ah. The fire brought you here.
Every generation, one young soul is drawn to this shrine before the journey begins.
The drakes sense it before we do.
This one has been restless for weeks. It was waiting for you.
Walk east along the Dustway. Let it show you what it can do.
When you have faced Warden Brask at the Scald and proven your bond — come back. The north gate will open.
post_starter: The Dustway stretches east from town.
Wild drakes hide in the tall grass — battle them. Your partner grows stronger with every fight.
Warden Brask waits at the Scald. She will test you both.
